description: This file defines data models, utility functions, and a data loader related to session management for an application, including session records, sessions list response, session token statistics, session rows, and session loading logic.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Model for default session settings, including model name and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Model representing individual session entries with various properties like key, display name, timestamps, and token counts.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Response model containing list of sessions, defaults, and metadata from the gateway.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Holds token count statistics for input, output, total, and context tokens, with helper methods for formatting and summaries.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Represents a session's data for UI display, implementing Identifiable, with properties like age, flags, and session details.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enum describing session types (direct, group, global, unknown) with helper methods for classification and labeling.

classes.name: SessionDefaults
classes.description: Data class for default model and context tokens.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Model representing AI model options with identifier, name, provider, and window size.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Structure capturing a snapshot of session storage, including path, defaults, and session rows.

classes.name: SessionLoader
classes.description: Main actor class responsible for asynchronously loading session data from the gateway.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a SessionKind from a string key.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for each SessionKind.

methods.name: tint
methods.description: Provides a color associated with each SessionKind.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a snapshot of sessions including metadata, with optional filters.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Loads session rows asynchronously using loadSnapshot.
